item.title: Kim Jae-seop: “Jung Won-oh Assaulted After Being Denied Overnight Stay with Female Staff” Jung Won-oh: “That’s Not True” (김재섭 “정원오, 여종업원과 외박 거절당해 폭행” 정원오 “사실 아냐”)
item.description:
Kim Jae-seop: “Jung Won-oh Assaulted After Being Denied Overnight Stay with Female Staff” Jung Won-oh: “That’s Not True” (김재섭 “정원오, 여종업원과 외박 거절당해 폭행” 정원오 “사실 아냐”)

People Power Party lawmaker Kim Jae-seop claimed on the 13th regarding the past assault case of Democratic Party’s Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh that “At a drinking gathering, he forced the café owner to provide an overnight stay with a female staff member, and when the owner refused, he threatened him, then assaulted a citizen who tried to stop him and police officers who arrived.” Candidate Jung responded, “This is an unfounded, one-sided claim.” Previously, Candidate Jung had explained about the incident, “It stemmed from a dispute over differing views on the May 18 Democratic Uprising, and I reflect on it.” (김재섭 국민의힘 의원이 13일 더불어민주당 정원오 서울시장 후보의 과거 폭행 사건과 관련해 “술자리에서 카페 주인에게 여종업원과의 외박을 강요하고 이를 거절하는 주인을 협박하다 이를 제지하는 시민과 출동한 경찰관을 폭행한 것”이라고 주장했다. 정 후보는 “사실이 아닌 일방적 주장”이라고 했다. 앞서 정 후보는 관련 사건에 대해 “5·18 민주화운동에 대한 인식 차이로 인한 다툼으로 인한 것이었으며 반성한다”고 설명해왔다.)

Kim, who serves as the standing co-chair of Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon’s campaign, held a press conference that morning in the communication hall at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, and released minutes from the Yangcheon-gu Council from 1995, when the incident occurred. Candidate Jung, while working as a secretary to the Yangcheon-gu district office head in October 1995, had reportedly engaged in a heated argument over political issues with a National Assembly aide named Lee at a café in Sinjeong-dong, Yangcheon-gu, and then assaulted Lee and police officers who arrived at the scene, resulting in a fine of 3 million won. (오세훈 서울시장 후보 캠프 상임선대위원장을 맡고 있는 김 의원은 이날 오전 서울 여의도 국회 소통관에서 기자회견을 열고 사건 당시인 1995년 양천구의회 속기록을 공개했다. 정 후보는 양천구청장 비서로 일하던 1995년 10월 양천구 신정동의 한 카페에서 국회의원 보좌관 이모씨와 정치 문제로 언쟁을 벌이다 이씨와 현장에 온 경찰관 등을 폭행한 혐의로 벌금 300만원을 선고받은 바 있다.)

Based on the council minutes, Kim argued, “Candidate Jung’s assault had nothing to do with the May 18 Democratic Uprising,” calling it a “sordid ‘drunk violence’ incident.” He went on, “Has Candidate Jung repeatedly lied to the public about his assault record? He should come clean and explain his assault history honestly to the public, even now.” (김 의원은 구의회 속기록을 근거로 “정 후보의 폭행은 5·18 민주화운동과는 전혀 무관했다”며 “지저분한 ‘주폭(酒暴)’ 사건”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “정 후보는 지금까지 자신의 폭행 전과에 대해 국민에게 반복적으로 거짓 해명을 해 온 것이냐”며 “정 후보는 지금이라도 자신의 폭행 전과에 대해 국민 앞에 솔직하게 해명하라”고 했다.)

The minutes include a question from council member Jang Haeng-il to district office head Yang Jae-ho regarding the incident. Council member Jang stated, “The chief secretary and the secretary, who should assist the district head, drank about 150,000 won worth of alcohol at a café and then demanded an overnight stay with a female staff member from the café owner, who refused. In response, the chief secretary and the secretary threatened the owner, saying things like, ‘Do you want to ruin your business?’ While arguing with the owner, a customer from a neighboring seat, who was an aide to a council member, tried to intervene. They then assaulted him, causing injuries requiring two weeks of medical treatment.” (속기록에는 당시 장행일 구의원이 양재호 구청장을 상대로 해당 사건과 관련해 질의하는 내용이 담겨있다. 장 구의원은 “구청장의 손발이 되어 보좌해야 할 비서실장과 비서가 카페에서 술을 15만원 상당을 마신 뒤 카페 주인에게 여종업원과 외박을 요구했으나 주인이 이를 거절했다”며 “그러자 비서실장과 비서는 ‘앞으로 영업을 다 해 먹을 것이냐’는 등으로 협박하면서 주인과 말다툼을 하던 중 옆 좌석에서 술을 마시고 있던 모의원의 비서관이라는 손님이 이를 만류하자 폭행을 가하여 2주 진단의 치료를 요하는 상해를 입혔다”고 했다.)

Council member Jang also said that Candidate Jung harmed himself at the time. He added, “When two police officers arrived after a 112 call to intervene, Chief Secretary Kim and Secretary Jung assaulted them. Secretary Jung then engaged in self-harm at the scene and obstructed the police officers’ duties, while Chief Secretary Kim fled about 50 meters before being caught.” (장 구의원은 당시 정 후보가 자해를 했다고도 했다. 그는 “112 신고를 받고 달려온 경찰관 2명이 말리려 하자 김 비서실장과 정 비서가 폭행을 가했다”며 “정 비서는 그 자리에서 자해 행위를 했고 경찰관의 공무집행방해를 했으며 김 실장은 약 50m 정도 도주하다가 붙잡혔다”고 했다.)

Kim stated, “To ensure the public’s right to know and the correct political choice for Seoul citizens, suspicions about Candidate Jung must be thoroughly investigated. Does Candidate Jung himself believe he is qualified to be Seoul mayor?” (김 의원은 “국민의 알 권리, 서울 시민의 올바른 정치적 선택권을 보장하기 위해 정 후보에 대한 의혹은 철저하게 검증돼야 한다”며 “정 후보 스스로 서울시장 후보의 자격이 있다고 생각하느냐”고 했다.)

In response, Candidate Jung’s side said, “This is an unfounded, one-sided claim.” Jung’s campaign released a statement saying, “Lawmaker Kim Jae-seop’s claims are not true and are merely one-sided. The ruling in the case at that time states, ‘Having shared drinks with the victim, Mr. Lee, an aide to a Democratic Liberal Party lawmaker, and discussing political matters, they raised their voices due to differing political affiliations, leading to a fight, and repeatedly punched and kicked the victim’s face and other parts.’” They argue that Kim’s claim that Candidate Jung forced the café owner to provide an overnight stay with a female staff member is false. Jung’s campaign released the court ruling and three news articles covering the incident. (이에 대해 정 후보 측은 “사실이 아닌 일방적 주장”이라고 했다. 정 후보 선대위는 이날 입장문을 내고 “김재섭 의원의 주장은 사실이 아니며, 일방적 주장에 불과하다”며 “당시 사건의 판결문에는 ‘민주자유당 소속 국회의원 박모씨 비서관인 피해자 이모씨와 함께 합석해 정치 관계 이야기 등을 나누다가 서로 정파가 다른 관계로 언성이 높아지면서 다툼이 되자 각 주먹과 발로 위 피해자의 얼굴 등을 수회 때리고’라고 판시하고 있다”고 했다. 정 후보가 술자리에서 카페 주인에게 여종업원과의 외박을 강요했다는 김 의원 주장은 허위라는 취지다. 정 후보 선대위는 판결문과 당시 사건을 보도한 언론 기사 3건을 공개했다.)

Jung’s side further stated, “Additionally, immediately after the incident, the media reported that ‘there was a quarrel over the June 27 election and the punishment of May 18-related individuals, leading to an assault on the victim.’ Media reports at the time covered both sides’ claims and investigative findings, which can be considered factual. Lawmaker Kim’s claims only reflect the Democratic Liberal Party’s side and are merely one-sided.” (정 후보 측은 이어 “또 당시 사건 직후 언론은 ‘6·27 선거와 5·18 관련자 처벌 문제를 놓고 말다툼을 벌이다 피해자에게 폭행’한 사실을 보도하고 있다”며 “당시 언론 보도는 양측의 주장과 수사기관을 취재해 보도한 것으로 사실에 부합한다고 할 수 있다. 김재섭 의원의 주장은 당시 민주자유당 측의 주장만 담고 있는 일방적 주장일 뿐”이라고도 했다.)

item.title: Busan: Jeon Jae-soo 43%, Park Hyung-joon 41%; Daegu: Kim Boo-kyum 44%, Choo Kyung-ho 41% — Dead Heat [Gallup Korea] (부산 전재수 43% 박형준 41%, 대구 김부겸 44% 추경호 41% 초접전 [한국갤럽])
item.description:
Busan: Jeon Jae-soo 43%, Park Hyung-joon 41%; Daegu: Kim Boo-kyum 44%, Choo Kyung-ho 41% — Dead Heat [Gallup Korea] (부산 전재수 43% 박형준 41%, 대구 김부겸 44% 추경호 41% 초접전 [한국갤럽])

A public opinion poll released on the 13th on the mayoral elections in Seoul, Busan, Daegu, and the Gyeongbuk governor race showed that the gap between ruling and opposition candidates has narrowed. In Busan, Daegu, and Gyeongnam, it's a tight race within the margin of error, and even in Seoul, the gap has significantly narrowed compared to a poll taken a month ago. (13일 공개된 서울·부산·대구시장과 경북지사 선거 여론조사 결과에서 여야 후보 간 격차가 줄어든 것으로 나타났다. 부산·대구·경남에서는 오차 범위 내 접전이 벌어지고 있고, 서울에서도 한 달 전 조사 때보다 격차가 크게 줄어들었다.)

◇Busan: Jeon Jae-soo 43%, Park Hyung-joon 41%… 11 percentage point gap from a month ago disappears (◇부산 전재수 43% 박형준 41%… 한 달 전 11%p 차 사라져)

According to a Busan mayoral election poll conducted by News1 and Gallup Korea on the 10th and 11th, 43% of respondents preferred Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo as Busan mayor, while 41% preferred People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon, which is within the margin of error (±3.5%p). In a hypothetical two-way matchup in a poll conducted by Gallup Korea for Segye Ilbo a month ago, Jeon had 51% and Park had 40%, a difference of 11 percentage points. (뉴스1·한국갤럽이 지난 10~11일 시행한 부산시장 선거 조사 결과에 따르면, 부산시장으로 더불어민주당 전재수 후보를 선호한다는 응답자는 43%, 국민의힘 박형준 후보를 선호한다는 응답자는 41%로, 오차 범위(±3.5%p) 안이었다. 한 달 전 세계일보 의뢰로 한국갤럽이 시행한 조사의 가상 양자 대결에서는 전 후보 51%, 박 후보 40%로 11%포인트(p) 차였다.)

By age group, Jeon significantly outpaced Park among those in their 40s (62% vs. 25%) and 50s (61% vs. 30%), but Park was ahead among those in their 70s or older (24% vs. 60%) and in their 60s (40% vs. 53%). Among those in their teens and 20s (29% vs. 35%), and those in their 30s (42% vs. 35%), the results were similar. Among conservatives, 64% preferred Park; among progressives, 78% preferred Jeon. Among moderates, Jeon received 47% and Park 34%. (응답자 연령별로 보면, 전 후보는 40대에서 62%대25%, 50대에서 61%대30%로 박 후보를 크게 앞섰으나, 70대 이상에서는 24%대60%, 60대에서도 40%대53%로 박 후보가 앞섰다. 10·20대에서는 29%대35%, 30대에서는 42%대35%로 비슷했다. 보수층은 64%가 박 후보, 진보층은 78%가 전 후보를 선호했고, 중도층에서는 전 후보 47%, 박 후보 34%였다.)

Regarding the special counsel bill for "fabricated indictments," 47% of respondents said it was 'inappropriate,' which was 17 percentage points higher than the 30% who said it was 'appropriate.' (조작 기소 특검법안에 대해서는 ‘적절하지 않다’는 응답자가 47%로, ‘적절하다’는 응답자 30%보다 17%p 많았다.)

On whether to empower the ruling party in the local elections, 43% said yes, compared to 41% who favored empowering the opposition, showing a similar split. (지방선거에서 여당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다는 응답자는 43%, 야당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다는 응답자는 41%로 비슷했다.)

◇Daegu: Kim Boo-kyum 44%, Choo Kyung-ho 41%… 'Fabricated indictment' special counsel bill deemed inappropriate by 54% (◇대구 김부겸 44% 추경호 41%… ‘조작 기소’ 특검법 부적절 54%)

In a Daegu mayoral election poll conducted by News1 and Gallup Korea on the 9th and 10th, Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum had 44% and People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho had 41%, within the margin of error. In a hypothetical two-way matchup in the Segye Ilbo and Gallup Korea poll a month ago, Kim had 53% and Choo had 36%, a 17 percentage point difference. (뉴스1·한국갤럽이 9~10일 시행한 대구시장 선거 조사에서는 민주당 김부겸 후보가 44%, 국민의힘 추경호 후보가 41%로, 오차 범위 안이었다. 한 달 전 세계일보·한국갤럽 조사의 가상 양자 대결에서는 김 후보 53%, 추 후보 36%로 17%p 차였다.)

By age group, Kim significantly outperformed Choo among those in their 40s (70% vs. 22%) and 50s (61% vs. 33%). However, among those in their 70s (22% vs. 66%), teens and 20s (20% vs. 42%), and 60s (39% vs. 52%), Choo was well ahead of Kim. Among conservatives, 67% preferred Choo; among progressives, 80% preferred Kim. Among moderates, Kim had 55% and Choo had 27%. (응답자 연령별로 보면, 김 후보는 40대에서 70%대22%, 50대에서 61%대33%로 추 후보를 크게 앞섰다. 그러나 70대에서는 22%대66%, 10·20대에서는 20%대42%, 60대에서는 39%대52%로 추 후보가 김 후보를 크게 앞섰다. 보수층의 67%는 추 후보, 진보층의 80%는 김 후보를 선호했고, 중도층에서는 김 후보 55%, 추 후보 27%였다.)

Regarding the special counsel bill for "fabricated indictments," 54% said it was 'inappropriate,' which was 32 percentage points higher than the 22% who said it was 'appropriate.' (조작 기소 특검법안에 대해서는 ‘적절하지 않다’가 54%로, ‘적절하다’ 22%보다 32%p 많았다.)

On whether to empower the opposition in the local elections, 42% said yes, compared to 40% who favored empowering the ruling party, showing a similar split. (지방선거에서 야당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다는 응답자는 42%, 여당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다는 응답자는 40%로 비슷했다.)

◇Gyeongnam: Kim Kyung-soo 45%, Park Wan-soo 38%… Special counsel deemed inappropriate by 48% (◇경남 김경수 45% 박완수 38%… 특검 부적절 48%)

In a Gyeongnam governor election poll conducted by News1 and Gallup Korea on the 11th and 12th, Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyung-soo had 45% and candidate Park Wan-soo had 38%, within the margin of error. In a hypothetical two-way matchup in the Segye Ilbo and Gallup Korea poll a month ago, Kim had 44% and Park had 40%, also within the margin of error. (뉴스1·한국갤럽이 11~12일 시행한 경남지사 선거 조사에서는 민주당 김경수 후보가 45%, 박완수 후보가 38%로, 오차 범위 안이었다. 한 달 전 세계일보·한국갤럽 조사의 가상 양자 대결에서도 김 후보 44%, 박 후보 40%로 오차 범위 안이었다.)

By age group, Kim outpaced Park among those in their 50s (65% vs. 29%), 40s (58% vs. 24%), and 30s (39% vs. 30%). Among those in their 70s or older, Park led Kim with 23% vs. 59%. Among teens and 20s, it was 35% vs. 34%, a close race. (응답자 연령별로 보면, 김 후보는 50대에서 65%대29%, 40대에서 58%대24%, 30대에서 39%대30%로 박 후보를 앞섰다. 70대 이상에서는 23%대59%로 박 후보가 김 후보를 앞섰다. 10·20대에서는 35%대34%로 비슷했다.)

Regarding the special counsel bill for "fabricated indictments," 48% said it was 'inappropriate,' which was 19 percentage points higher than the 29% who said it was 'appropriate.' (조작 기소 특검법안에 대해서는 ‘적절하지 않다’가 48%로, ‘적절하다’ 29%보다 19%p 많았다.)

On whether to empower the ruling party in the local elections, 43% said yes, compared to 38% who favored empowering the opposition, showing a similar split. (지방선거에서 여당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다는 응답자는 43%, 야당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다는 응답자는 38%로 비슷했다.)

◇Seoul: Jung Won-oh 46%, Oh Se-hoon 38%… A month ago it was 52% vs. 37% (◇서울 정원오 46% 오세훈 38%… 한 달 전에는 52%대37%)

According to a Seoul mayoral election poll conducted by Gallup Korea for News1 on the 9th and 10th, 46% of respondents preferred Democratic Party candidate Jung Won-oh as Seoul mayor, 8 percentage points more than the 38% who preferred People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon. Reform Party candidate Kim Jung-chul, Justice Party candidate Kwon Young-guk, and Women's Party candidate Yoo Ji-hye each received 1%, 6% had no preferred candidate, and 7% said they didn't know or refused to answer. In the Segye Ilbo and Gallup Korea poll a month ago, a hypothetical two-way matchup gave Jung 52% and Oh 37%, a 15 percentage point gap. (뉴스1 의뢰로 여론조사 업체 한국갤럽이 지난 9~10일 시행한 서울시장 선거 조사에서는, 서울시장으로 더불어민주당 정원오 후보를 선호한다는 응답자는 46%로, 국민의힘 오세훈 후보를 선호한다는 응답자 38%보다 8%p 많았다. 개혁신당 김정철 후보, 정의당 권영국 후보, 여성의당 유지혜 후보를 선호하는 응답자가 각각 1%였고, 지지 후보가 없다는 응답자는 6%, 잘 모르겠다고 답하거나 응답을 거절한 사람은 7%였다. 한 달 전 세계일보·한국갤럽 조사에서는 가상 양자 대결에서 정 후보가 52%, 오 후보가 37%를 받아, 15%p 격차였다.)

By age group, Jung significantly outpaced Oh among those in their 50s (64% vs. 25%) and 40s (62% vs. 26%), while results were similar in their 60s (50% vs. 44%) and 30s (40% vs. 38%). Oh was ahead among those in their 70s or older, receiving 63% compared to Jung's 30%. Among teens and 20s (ages 18–29), Oh had 34% and Jung had 27%. Among conservatives, 70% preferred Oh and 21% preferred Jung; among progressives, 75% preferred Jung and 11% preferred Oh. Among moderates, Jung had 47% and Oh had 33%. (응답자 연령별로 보면, 정 후보는 50대에서 64%대25%, 40대에서 62%대26%로 오 후보를 크게 앞섰고, 60대에서 50%대44%, 30대에서 40%대38%로 비슷했다. 오 후보는 70대 이상에서 63%를 받아, 30%를 받은 정 후보를 앞섰다. 10·20대(18~29세)에서는 오 후보가 34%, 정 후보가 27%였다. 보수층은 70%가 오 후보, 21%가 정 후보를 선호했고, 진보층은 75%가 정 후보, 11%가 오 후보를 선호했다. 중도층은 정 후보 47%, 오 후보 33%였다.)

When asked which candidate would best implement real estate policies for Seoul, 34% cited Jung and 30% cited Oh, within the margin of error. Additionally, 43% positively evaluated the Lee Jae-myung administration's real estate policies, while 42% evaluated them negatively, also within the margin of error. Regarding whether the long-term holding special deduction, which reduces capital gains tax when selling a home, should be maintained for non-resident single-home owners, 35% said it should 'be maintained at the current level,' the highest response. Another 15% said the deduction rate should be 'increased,' meaning taxes should be further reduced. Responses for 'lowering the deduction rate' and 'abolishing it' were 16% and 14%, respectively. (서울시의 부동산 정책을 가장 잘 추진할 후보를 묻는 물음에는 정 후보라는 응답자가 34%, 오 후보 30%로, 오차 범위 안이었다. 이재명 정부 부동산 정책을 긍정적으로 평가한 응답자가 43%, 부정 평가한 응답자가 42%로, 역시 오차 범위 안이었다. 집을 팔 때 매기는 양도소득세를 깎아주는 장기보유특별공제를 비거주 1주택자에게도 유지해야 하는지와 관련한 물음에는 ‘현행 수준을 유지해야 한다’는 응답자가 35%로 가장 많았다. ‘현행보다 공제 비율을 높여야 한다’, 즉 세금을 더 깎아줘야 한다는 응답자도 15%에 달했다. ‘현행보다 공제 비율을 낮춰야 한다’거나 ‘폐지해야 한다’는 응답자는 각각 16%, 14%였다.)

Regarding the special counsel bill for "fabricated indictments," which would grant the special counsel the authority to dismiss indictments related to President Lee Jae-myung, 49% said it was 'inappropriate,' 18 percentage points higher than the 31% who said it was 'appropriate.' (특검에 이재명 대통령 관련 사건의 공소를 취소할 수 있는 권한을 주는 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법안에 대해서는 ‘적절하지 않다’는 응답자가 49%로, ‘적절하다’는 응답자 31%보다 18%p 많았다.)

In this local election, 48% said they should 'empower the ruling party for state affairs support,' which was 10 percentage points higher than the 38% who said they should 'empower the opposition for checks on the administration.' (이번 지방선거에서 ‘국정 지원을 위해 여당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다’는 응답자는 48%로, ‘정권 견제를 위해 야당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다’는 응답자 38%보다 10%p 많았다.)

The News1 and Gallup Korea polls were conducted via wireless telephone interviews, with a sampling error of ±3.5%p at a 95% confidence level. The Seoul mayoral poll targeted 802 individuals aged 18 and older living in Seoul on the 9th and 10th, with a response rate of 11.0%. The Busan mayoral poll targeted 801 individuals aged 18 and older living in Busan on the 10th and 11th, with a response rate of 14.7%. The Daegu mayoral poll targeted 803 individuals aged 18 and older living in Daegu on the 9th and 10th, with a response rate of 20.3%. The Gyeongnam governor poll targeted 804 individuals aged 18 and older living in Gyeongnam on the 11th and 12th, with a response rate of 13.4%. (뉴스1·한국갤럽 조사는 무선 전화 인터뷰 방식으로 진행했고, 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에서 3.5%p였다. 서울시장 선거 조사는 지난 9~10일 서울에 사는 18세 이상 802명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 11.0%였다. 부산시장 선거 조사는 지난 10~11일 부산에 사는 18세 이상 801명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 14.7%였다. 대구시장 선거 조사는 지난 9~10일 대구에 사는 18세 이상 803명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 20.3%였다. 경남지사 선거 조사는 지난 11~12일 경남에 사는 18세 이상 804명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 13.4%였다.)

The Segye Ilbo and Gallup Korea polls were also conducted via wireless telephone interviews, with a sampling error of ±3.5%p at a 95% confidence level. The Seoul mayoral poll targeted 803 individuals living in Seoul on the 10th and 11th of last month, with a response rate of 11.9%. The Busan mayoral poll targeted 805 individuals aged 18 and older living in Busan on the 9th and 10th of last month, with a response rate of 12.8%. The Daegu mayoral poll targeted 805 individuals living in Daegu on the 10th and 11th of last month, with a response rate of 13.9%. The Gyeongnam governor poll targeted 806 individuals living in Gyeongnam on the 7th and 8th of last month, with a response rate of 15.4%. (세계일보·한국갤럽 조사도 무선 전화 인터뷰 방식으로 진행했고, 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에서 3.5%p였다. 서울시장 선거 조사는 지난달 10~11일 서울에 사는 803명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 11.9%였다. 부산시장 선거 조사는 지난달 9~10일 부산에 사는 18세 이상 805명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 12.8%였다. 대구시장 선거 조사는 지난달 10~11일 대구에 사는 805명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 13.9%였다. 경남지사 선거 조사는 지난달 7~8일 경남에 사는 806명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 15.4%였다.)

For details on each poll, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (각 조사의 자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지를 참조하면 된다.)

item.title: Chu Mi-ae: “Claims That ‘Fabricated Indictment’ Special Counsel Bill Unites Conservatives Is Manipulation” (추미애 “조작 기소 특검법에 보수 결집한다는 주장은 선동”)
item.description:
Chu Mi-ae: “Claims That ‘Fabricated Indictment’ Special Counsel Bill Unites Conservatives Is Manipulation” (추미애 “조작 기소 특검법에 보수 결집한다는 주장은 선동”)

Gyeonggi Province Governor candidate Chu Mi-ae of the Democratic Party of Korea dismissed on the 13th the assertion that a special counsel bill targeting "fabricated indictments"—which would grant a special counsel the power to revoke indictments in cases related to President Lee Jae-myung—had galvanized conservative support ahead of the June 3 local elections, stating that "such manipulation must not be allowed." <<> Speaking on SBS Radio’s “Kim Tae-hyun’s Political Show” that morning, Chu responded to a host’s comment that reports suggested conservative forces were rallying in the Yeongnam region following the introduction of the fabricated indictment special counsel bill. She asserted, "In elections, one can find a hundred excuses if one wants to. The election should not be manipulated in this way." <<> Chu further argued, "The People Power Party, which fostered the insurrection, has consistently denied that the December 3 illegal martial law constituted an insurrection. The same applies to the fabricated indictment special counsel bill." <<> Addressing criticism of the bill, she said, "Opposing efforts to uncover fabricated indictments is merely an attempt to suppress justice." <<> She continued, "If the prosecution has abused its investigative and indictment powers for political purposes, the truth must be uncovered, and if investigations confirm wrongdoing, punishment must follow." She added, "If there are victims who have suffered unjustly, we must find ways to restore their honor." <<> Regarding internal calls within the Democratic Party to revise the special counsel bill, Chu noted, "As long as the principle holds that proper investigations into unjust indictments and abuse of prosecutorial power are conducted—revealing the truth and achieving victim recovery—the methods to achieve this can be flexibly adjusted." (더불어민주당 추미애 경기지사 후보는 13일 이재명 대통령 관련 사건의 공소를 취소할 권한을 특검에게 주는 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법안이 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 보수 결집을 불러왔다는 주장을 “선동돼서는 안 된다”며 일축했다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim: "Broad upward pressure on prices... Urge price stabilization measures" (金총리 “물가 전반 상승 압력… 가격 안정화 대책 강구하라”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim: "Broad upward pressure on prices... Urge price stabilization measures" (金총리 “물가 전반 상승 압력… 가격 안정화 대책 강구하라”)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 13th, "There is upward pressure on overall prices," adding, "This is a situation where the government must dedicate all efforts to managing prices." (김민석 국무총리는 13일 “물가 전반에 상승 압력이 가해지고 있다”며 “정부가 물가 관리에 전력을 다해야 할 상황”이라고 말했다.)

Kim made these remarks while chairing an emergency economic control meeting at the Government Complex Seoul on the morning of the same day. (김 총리는 이날 오전 정부서울청사에서 비상경제본부 회의를 주재하며 이같이 말했다.)

Kim first said, "It is truly fortunate that the current account surplus for March reached a record monthly high of $37.3 billion, and the GDP for the first quarter also grew by 1.7% year-on-year, maintaining a solid growth trajectory." He added, "Thanks to the government's efforts and the collaboration of the public and businesses, the supply and demand of key items such as crude oil and naphtha have remained relatively stable." (김 총리는 먼저 “3월 경상수지가 월간 기준 최대 규모인 373억 달러 흑자를 기록했고, 1분기 GDP(국내총생산)도 전년 동기 대비 1.7% 증가하는 등 견조한 성장세를 이어가고 있는 것은 참으로 다행스러운 일”이라고 했다. “정부가 노력하고 국민 여러분과 기업이 함께 협력해 원유, 나프타 등 주요 품목의 수급도 비교적 안정적으로 지속되고 있다”고 했다.)

However, Kim also noted, "It is still too early to be complacent, and this is a time when we must strive to secure additional supplies, such as through diversifying import sources." (김 총리는 그러면서도 “여전히 안심하기는 이르고, 수입선 다변화 등 추가 물량 확보에 노력을 펼쳐야 할 시기”라고 했다.)

Kim further stated, "With the rise in international prices of crude oil and other items, there is upward pressure on overall prices," and urged, "I ask that the Ministry of Economy and Finance and other relevant ministries closely monitor price trends for directly related items like petrochemical products, as well as agricultural, fishery, and food products closely tied to people's livelihoods, and devise price stabilization measures." (김 총리는 또 “원유 등의 국제 가격 상승에 따라 물가 전반에 상승 압력이 있다”며 “재정경제부를 비롯한 관계 부처는 석유화학 제품 등 직접 관련 있는 품목과, 국민 생활에 밀접한 농수산물과 식료품 등 여러 부분의 가격 동향을 면밀하게 점검하고, 가격 안정화 대책을 강구해 주기 바란다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, Kim remarked, "In this situation, there are reports that citizens are enjoying domestic travel rather than overseas trips," adding, "When challenges arise, it seems not only difficulties emerge but also new circumstances and opportunities." He further noted, "We should also explore various efforts to ensure that the revitalization of 'K-tourism' becomes a sustained growth driver rather than a temporary phenomenon." (김 총리는 한편 “이 상황에서 국민들께서 해외여행이 아니라 국내 지방 여행을 즐긴다는 보도가 있다”며 “어려운 일들이 있을 때 어려운 일만 있는 것이 아니라, 새로운 상황과 기회가 생겨나는 측면이 나타나는 것 같다”고 했다. 그러면서 “‘K-관광’ 활성화가 일시적 현상이 아니라 하나의 성장 동력이 될 수 있도록, 다양한 방안의 노력도 강구해야 할 것 같다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Breaking] People Power Party Selects Four-Term Lawmaker Park Deok-heum as Candidate for Vice National Assembly Speaker ([속보] 국민의힘, 후반기 국회부의장 후보로 4선 박덕흠 선출)
item.description:
[Breaking] People Power Party Selects Four-Term Lawmaker Park Deok-heum as Candidate for Vice National Assembly Speaker ([속보] 국민의힘, 후반기 국회부의장 후보로 4선 박덕흠 선출)

On the 13th, the People Power Party selected four-term lawmaker Park Deok-heum (representing Boeun, Okcheon, Yeongdong, and Goesan districts) as its candidate for Vice Speaker of the National Assembly for the latter half of the session. Rep. Park also currently serves as the chair of the People Power Party's Nomination Management Committee. (국민의힘이 13일 국회 후반기 국회부의장 후보자로 4선 박덕흠(추욱 보은·옥천·영동·괴산) 의원을 선출했다. 박 의원은 현재 국민의힘 공천관리위원장도 맡고 있다.)

The People Power Party held a general meeting of lawmakers on this day and elected Rep. Park as its candidate for Vice National Assembly Speaker. The race for the party's Vice Speaker candidacy was a three-way contest among six-term lawmaker Cho Kyung-tae (representing Saha-eul, Busan), five-term lawmaker Jo Bae-sook (proportional representative), and Rep. Park. (국민의힘은 이날 의원 총회를 열고 박 의원을 국회부의장 후보로 선출했다. 국민의힘 국회부의장 후보는 6선 조경태(부산 사하을) 의원, 5선 조배숙(비례대표) 의원과 박 의원이 3파전을 벌였다.)

During the general meeting of lawmakers, a vote was held to select the candidate, and out of a total of 101 votes cast, Rep. Park received 59 votes and was chosen as the candidate. The National Assembly is expected to hold a plenary session to finalize Rep. Park's election as Vice Speaker of the National Assembly. <<>> (이날 의원 총회에서 후보 선출을 위한 의원들 투표가 이뤄졌고, 총 투표수 101표 중 박 의원이 59표를 받아 후보로 선출됐다. 국회는 본회의를 열어 박 의원을 국회부의장으로 최종 선출할 예정이다.)

item.title: Kim Boo-kyum "I Want to Visit Park Geun-hye... Sorry to Daegu Citizens for Living in Yangpyeong" (김부겸 “박근혜 찾아뵙고 싶다...양평 거주는 대구 시민께 죄송”)
item.description:
Kim Boo-kyum "I Want to Visit Park Geun-hye... Sorry to Daegu Citizens for Living in Yangpyeong" (김부겸 “박근혜 찾아뵙고 싶다...양평 거주는 대구 시민께 죄송”)

Kim Boo-kyum, a preliminary candidate for Daegu mayor from the Democratic Party of Korea, said, "I want to formally request to pay a visit to former President Park Geun-hye," a day before the official candidate registration for the election. (김부겸 더불어민주당 대구시장 예비후보가 본 선거 후보 등록을 하루 앞두고 “박근혜 전 대통령 예방을 공식적으로 요청드리고 싶다”고 말했다.)

Candidate Kim met with reporters at his election office in Duryu-dong, Dalseo-gu, Daegu on the 13th and stated, "I had conveyed through various channels that I would like to visit her sometime, but I haven't received a particular reply yet." (김부겸 후보는 13일 대구 달서구 두류동 선거사무소에서 기자들과 만나 “그동안 이런저런 요로를 통해 한번 찾아뵙겠다는 말씀을 전했는데 아직 특별한 답을 받지 못했다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

He explained, "It was about visiting the region's elders before the full-fledged election begins, saying 'I'd like to visit.' If she tells me when and where to come, I would like to visit." (그는 “본격적인 선거에 들어가기 전 지역 어른들을 찾아뵙는 차원에서 ‘찾아뵙겠다’고 한 것”이라며 “언제, 어디로 오라고 말씀하시면 찾아뵙고 싶다”고 했다.)

Regarding the reactions from citizens who felt disappointed that he had moved from Daegu to Yangpyeong, Gyeonggi Province in the past, Candidate Kim said, "I sold my home in Manchon-dong, Suseong-gu, Daegu three months after being appointed Prime Minister. At that time, I thought I would finish my public service as Prime Minister and retire from politics, and I planned to build a country house (with my family) and move (to Yangpyeong), so I arranged things that way." (김 후보는 과거 대구에서 경기 양평으로 거처를 옮겨 섭섭하다는 시민들의 반응과 관련해선 “대구 수성구 만촌동 집을 국무총리에 임명되고 석 달 후 팔았다”며 “그때 생각에는 이제 총리직을 수행하며 공직을 끝내고 정계를 은퇴한다는 생각, 또 (가족과) 전원주택을 지어 (양평으로) 간다는 생각에 그렇게 정리를 한 것”이라고 했다.)

He added, "As a result, I came back, and many people pointed out that whether it was good or bad, it hurt Daegu citizens. I take this opportunity to bow my head and say I am truly sorry in many ways to the citizens I have hurt." (그러면서 “결과적으로 제가 다시 돌아와 많은 분들의 이야기가 그것이 좋든, 싫든 대구 시민에게 상처를 줬다는 지적을 해 주셨다”며 “이 기회를 빌려 상처를 드린 시민들께 정말 여러 가지로 죄송하다”고 고개를 숙였다.)

He continued, "I promise to work harder for the citizens than a child who left home and returned." (이어 “집 나갔다가 돌아온 자식보다 더 열심히 시민을 위해 일하겠다는 약속을 드린다”고 했다.)

item.title: PM Kim: "Support labor-management dialogue to prevent any possibility of strike at Samsung Electronics" (金총리 “삼성전자 어떤 경우에도 파업 않게 노사 대화 지원하라”)
item.description:
PM Kim: "Support labor-management dialogue to prevent any possibility of strike at Samsung Electronics" (金총리 “삼성전자 어떤 경우에도 파업 않게 노사 대화 지원하라”)

With the post-mediation of Samsung Electronics' labor-management negotiations breaking down and a union strike imminent, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok instructed relevant ministries on the 13th to "support labor-management dialogue to ensure it does not lead to a strike under any circumstances." (삼성전자의 노사 협상 사후 조정이 결렬되고 노조의 파업이 임박하자 김민석 국무총리가 13일 관계 부처에 “어떠한 경우에도 파업으로 이어지지 않게끔 노사 대화를 지원하라”고 지시했다.)

According to the Prime Minister's Office, Prime Minister Kim held an emergency meeting with relevant ministers on the morning of the same day at the government complex in Seoul regarding the Samsung Electronics strike. (총리실에 따르면, 김 총리는 이날 오전 정부서울청사 총리 집무실에서 삼성전자 파업 관련 긴급 관계 장관 회의를 열었다.)

Prime Minister Kim received reports on the breakdown of post-mediation from the Minister of Employment and Labor and the Vice Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy, and discussed the government's future response direction concerning the Samsung Electronics strike. (김 총리는 노동부 장관과 산업부 차관으로부터 사후 조정 결렬 결과를 보고받고, 향후 삼성전자 파업과 관련한 정부의 대응 방향을 논의했다.)

Expressing regret over the breakdown of post-mediation, Prime Minister Kim instructed, "Considering the significant ripple effects on the national economy, manage the situation closely at the government level." (김 총리는 사후 조정이 결렬된 데 대해 안타까움을 표시하면서 “국민 경제에 미치는 파급 효과의 중대성을 고려해, 정부 차원에서 상황을 면밀히 관리해 나가라”라고 지시했다.)

The Prime Minister's Office also stated that he urged, "Actively support continuous dialogue between labor and management to ensure it does not lead to a strike under any circumstances." (또 “어떠한 경우에도 파업으로 이어지지 않게끔, 노사 간 대화가 지속적으로 이뤄지도록 적극 지원하라”고 당부했다고 총리실은 전했다.)

On the 11th and 12th, Samsung Electronics' labor and management attempted post-mediation for negotiations, but the mediation fell through when the union declared a breakdown on the 12th. The union plans to proceed with the strike as scheduled on the 21st. (지난 11~12일 삼성전자 노사는 협상 사후 조정을 시도했으나, 12일 노조 측이 결렬을 선언하면서 조정이 무산됐다. 노조는 오는 21일 파업을 예정대로 진행하겠다는 계획이다.)

item.title: Cho Hyun: “There Are Multiple Potential Actors That Could Have Launched the Aircraft, Not Only Iran…Possibility of Militias” (조현 “비행체 발사할 주체, 이란만 해도 여럿...민병대 가능성도”)
item.description:
Cho Hyun: “There Are Multiple Potential Actors That Could Have Launched the Aircraft, Not Only Iran…Possibility of Militias” (조현 “비행체 발사할 주체, 이란만 해도 여럿...민병대 가능성도”)

Foreign Minister Cho Hyun stated on the 13th that it cannot be definitively concluded that the Iranian government was the entity that launched an unidentified aircraft at the South Korean vessel HMM Namu in the Strait of Hormuz, adding that there is also a possibility it could have been a militia. <<> Minister Cho met with reporters at the Government Complex Seoul and responded to a question about whether the aircraft that struck the Namu is likely a drone, saying, "It is difficult to specify at this point." He added, "In particular, there are multiple potential actors that could have fired such a thing, not only Iran. There could also be militias." <<> Minister Cho’s remarks are interpreted to mean that even if the aircraft that struck the Namu is confirmed to be an Iranian-made drone, as many experts have analyzed, it cannot be determined which Iranian entity launched it. <<> When asked whether he is also considering the possibility that the attacking entity could be a militia, Minister Cho responded, "It’s not that I’m considering it, but rather that there is a possibility." <<> Currently, experts are suggesting that the aircraft that struck the Namu could be a suicide drone such as the Shahed, which Iran has frequently used in its conflict with the United States. The Shahed is operated not only by Iran’s regular military and Revolutionary Guard, which developed the weapon, but also by the Houthi rebels and militias backed by Iran. <<> The government plans to bring the aircraft engine debris collected from the Namu back to South Korea for precise analysis to determine the attacking entity. When asked about the timing of the debris's arrival in South Korea, Minister Cho stated, "It should come quickly." (조현 외교부 장관은 13일 호르무즈 해협에서 한국 선박 HMM 나무호에 미상 비행체를 발사할만한 주체가 이란 정부라고 단정할 수 없고 민병대 등일 가능성도 있다고 했다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk: "Kim Yong-nam Will Block Prosecution Reform If Elected... I Will Complete the Reform" (조국 “김용남, 의원 되면 검찰 개혁 막을 것... 내가 개혁 마무리”)
item.description:
Cho Kuk: "Kim Yong-nam Will Block Prosecution Reform If Elected... I Will Complete the Reform" (조국 “김용남, 의원 되면 검찰 개혁 막을 것... 내가 개혁 마무리”)

Cho Kuk, candidate of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party running in the by-election for the National Assembly seat in Pyeongtaek-eul, Gyeonggi Province, claimed on the 13th that Kim Yong-nam, candidate of the Democratic Party of Korea, supports recognizing the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights, and that if Kim enters the National Assembly, he could oppose prosecution reform. Candidate Cho emphasized, "Completing prosecution reform is undoubtedly something I can do," insisting that he should be elected. He stated that discussions on unification could only take place two to three weeks later. <<> In an interview on MBC Radio’s 'Kim Jong-bae's Focus' that morning, Candidate Cho was pointed out by the host that the Cho Kuk Innovation Party had not fielded candidates for regional and local council seats in Pyeongtaek. In response, Cho said, "Doesn't the Democratic Party have candidates for Pyeongtaek mayor and regional and local council seats?" adding, "I believe votes should be concentrated on those individuals." <<> However, regarding the National Assembly seat, he stated, "I intend to clearly compete and win (against Candidate Kim, rather than concentrating votes for him)." <<> Candidate Cho cited the issue of 'prosecution reform' as the reason he must defeat Candidate Kim. He said, "Candidate Kim takes the position of recognizing the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights within the scope of the identity of the charges, but I believe, in principle, those rights should be abolished and only recognized in very exceptional, extreme cases." He added, "Prosecution reform needs to be completed, and who can do it? Undoubtedly, I am the one who can." <<> The host asked, "Does the outcome of prosecution reform change depending on which single lawmaker gets elected?" Candidate Cho replied, "It can change." He continued, "During the Moon Jae-in administration, a former prosecutor candidate named Cho Eung-cheon, recruited by President Moon, became a lawmaker and endlessly opposed prosecution reform. If (Candidate Kim is elected and becomes a lawmaker), something like this could happen again." Cho added, "Candidate Kim has never changed his stance on the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights. I predict that if he becomes a lawmaker in the future, he will either consistently oppose prosecution reform according to his convictions or block it in an insufficient manner." <<> When the host asked, "By that logic, are you saying the Democratic Party's candidate nomination itself was wrong?" Candidate Cho responded, "A political party has the right to recommend candidates based on its internal criteria and discussions. Since I am not a member of the Democratic Party, I am not qualified to comment on that." <<> Regarding the issue of unification with Candidate Kim or Candidate Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party, Cho stated, "This is not the time for candidates to discuss unification." He said, "It would be meaningful to discuss the unification issue two to three weeks later, after each candidate has shared their vision and values with voters, and after voters have had a chance to verify and evaluate them." (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 출마한 조국 조국혁신당 후보는 13일 김용남 더불어민주당 후보가 검찰의 보완 수사권을 인정하자는 입장이라며 김 후보가 국회에 입성하면 검찰 개혁을 반대할 수 있다고 주장했다. 조 후보는 “검찰 개혁 마무리는 단연코 제가 할 수 있다”며 자신이 당선돼야 한다고 강조했다. 단일화 논의는 2~3주 뒤에나 할 수 있다고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Won-oh: "Reduce Property Tax for Single-Home Owners with No Income"...Seongdong and Gangnam to Benefit (정원오 “소득 없는 1주택자 재산세 감면”…성동·강남 수혜)
item.description:
Jung Won-oh: "Reduce Property Tax for Single-Home Owners with No Income"...Seongdong and Gangnam to Benefit (정원오 “소득 없는 1주택자 재산세 감면”…성동·강남 수혜)

Jung Won-oh, a candidate of the Democratic Party of Korea, announced on the 13th a pledge to reduce property taxes for single-home owners with no income. This year, the publicly announced prices of apartment complexes in Seoul rose by 18.6% compared to last year, and the aim is to alleviate the property tax burden resulting from this increase. (정원오 더불어민주당 후보가 소득없는 1주택자의 재산세를 감면하겠다는 공약을 13일 내놨다. 올해 서울 공동주택 공시가격은 지난해 대비 18.6% 상승했는데, 이로 인한 재산세 부담을 경감해주겠다는 취지다.)

In particular, the districts of Seongdong and Gangnam, which have a high concentration of expensive apartments and thus saw a significant rise in publicly announced prices, are expected to benefit. Looking at this year's publicly announced apartment prices, Seongdong-gu, where candidate Jung Won-oh served as district mayor, recorded the highest fluctuation rate in Seoul at 28.98%. This was followed by Gangnam-gu (25.83%) and Songpa-gu (25.46%). (특히 고가 아파트가 밀집해 공시가격 상승률이 큰 성동구와 강남 지역이 수혜를 입을 것으로 보인다. 올해 공동주택 공시가격을 보면 정원오 후보가 구청장을 지낸 성동구가 28.98%로 서울에서 가장 높은 변동률을 보였다. 이어 강남구(25.83%), 송파구(25.46%) 순이었다.)

During a press conference on the same day, Candidate Jung stated, "Together with the 25 district mayor candidates of Seoul, we will promote a temporary measure to reduce the increase in property taxes this year resulting from the rise in publicly announced prices." He added, "This is about easing the property tax burden for retired generations who live in and protect their only home, not for multi-home owners with speculative purposes." (정 후보는 이날 회견에서 “서울시 25개 구청장 후보들과 함께, 공시가격 상승으로 올해 늘어난 재산세 증가분을 한시적으로 감면하는 조치를 추진하겠다”며 “투기 목적의 다주택자가 아니라, 평생 살아온 집 한 채를 지키며 살아가는 은퇴 세대의 재산세 부담을 덜어드리겠다는 것”이라고 했다.)

The target is limited to single-home owners who are above a certain age and have no business or earned income. It was stated that the age criteria would be reasonably reviewed, referencing the current comprehensive real estate tax senior citizen deduction standard of 60 years of age. (대상은 1주택자 중, 일정 연령 이상이면서 사업소득과 근로소득이 없는 시민으로 한정했다. 연령 기준은 현행 종합부동산세 고령자 세액공제 기준인 만 60세를 참고해 합리적으로 검토하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Furthermore, Candidate Jung announced, "We will push to reflect the reduction of this year's increase in the property tax levied in September, but depending on certain conditions, we will also consider handling the July portion through a refund method." (그러면서 정 후보는 “오는 9월 부과되는 재산세에 올해 증가분 감면이 반영될 수 있도록 추진하되, 일정 여건에 따라 7월분은 환급 방식으로 처리하는 방안도 검토하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, on the same day, Representative Kim Jae-seop of the People Power Party claimed regarding Candidate Jung's past assault record, "It had absolutely nothing to do with the May 18 Democratic Uprising," and "It was a case where, during a drinking session, he forced a café owner to have his female employee stay out overnight and threatened the owner when he refused." (한편, 이날 국민의힘 김재섭 의원은 정 후보의 과거 폭행 전과와 관련해 5·18 민주화운동과는 전혀 무관했다”며 “술자리에서 카페 주인에게 여종업원과의 외박을 강요하고 이를 거절하는 주인을 협박한 사건”이라고 주장했다.)

In response, Candidate Jung avoided answering that question during the Q&A session following the press conference. An aide to Jung stated, "Today, we will only answer questions related to the topic." This led to some friction with certain media outlets. (이에 대해 정 후보는 회견을 마치고 이어진 질의응답 과정에서 해당 답변을 피했다. 정 후보측은 “오늘은 질문과 관련해서만 답변을 하겠다”고 했다. 이 과정에서 일부 언론과 마찰이 빚어지기도 했다.)

Earlier, regarding this allegation, Candidate Jung's side issued a statement saying, "Representative Kim's claims are not true and are merely one-sided assertions," and added, "Representative Kim Jae-seop's claims are only one-sided arguments that include the stance of the then-Democratic Liberal Party." (앞서 해당 의혹에 대해 정 후보측은 입장문을 내고 “김 의원 주장은 사실이 아니며 일방적 주장에 불과하다”며 “김재섭 의원의 주장은 당시 민주자유당 측 주장만 담고 있는 일방적 주장일 뿐”이라고 했다.)

item.title: UN Human Rights Chief Expresses Interest in North Korea Human Rights Issues; PM Kim Says “Let’s Continue Communicating” (유엔 인권대표 “北 인권 문제에 관심” 金총리 “소통하자”)
item.description:
UN Human Rights Chief Expresses Interest in North Korea Human Rights Issues; PM Kim Says “Let’s Continue Communicating” (유엔 인권대표 “北 인권 문제에 관심” 金총리 “소통하자”)

The UN High Commissioner for Human Rights expressed interest in North Korea’s human rights issues during a meeting with Prime Minister Kim Min-seok on the 13th. Prime Minister Kim responded, “Let’s continue to communicate.” (유엔 인권최고대표가 13일 김민석 국무총리를 만난 자리에서 북한 인권 문제에 대해 관심을 표했다. 김 총리는 “계속해서 소통해 나가자”고 답했다.)

According to the Prime Minister’s Office, UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk visited South Korea to attend the World Human Rights Cities Forum held in Gwangju and met with Prime Minister Kim at the Government Complex Seoul that morning. (총리실에 따르면, 볼커 튀르크 유엔 인권최고대표는 광주에서 열리는 세계인권도시포럼 참석차 방한해 이날 오전 정부서울청사에서 김 총리를 만났다.)

High Commissioner Türk told Prime Minister Kim, “I am pleased to visit South Korea, which is an important strategic partner of the Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) and contributes in various ways to the global human rights stage.” (튀르크 최고대표는 김 총리에게 “인권최고대표사무소(OHCHR)의 중요한 전략적 파트너이자 세계 인권 무대에서 다방면으로 기여하고 있는 한국을 방문해 기쁘게 생각한다”고 했다.)

He added, “Although there are many challenges, such as recent geopolitical crises and challenges to multilateralism, human rights can be a key to overcoming divisions and building trust in the fields of international peace and security,” and expressed hope to “continue strengthening cooperation with South Korea in the future.” (이어 “최근 지정학적 위기, 다자주의에 대한 도전 등 어려움이 많으나, 인권은 국제 평화·안보 분야에서 분열을 극복하고 신뢰를 구축하는 핵심 열쇠가 될 수 있다”며 “앞으로 한국과 협력을 지속 강화해 나가기를 희망한다”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Kim stated, “Our government places great importance on values such as human rights, democracy, and life.” He continued, “South Korea aims to repay the help it received from the international community in the past by contributing to global development and prosperity,” adding, “In this process, let’s work closely together between South Korea and the OHCHR.” (김 총리는 “우리 정부는 인권과 민주주의, 생명 등의 가치를 매우 중시한다”고 했다. 이어 “한국은 국제사회의 발전과 번영에 기여함으로써 과거 국제사회로부터 받은 도움을 되돌려주고자 한다”며 “이 과정에서 한국과 OHCHR이 긴밀히 협력해 나가자”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, High Commissioner Türk reportedly also showed interest in issues related to artificial intelligence (AI). In response, Prime Minister Kim introduced that “South Korea, as a leading AI nation, is pushing for the establishment of a ‘Global AI Hub’ in collaboration with UN agencies.” The Global AI Hub is a concept envisioned by the South Korean government to gather AI-related functions from various UN subsidiary bodies, specialized agencies, and partner organizations in one place to foster mutual cooperation, and South Korea has proposed its establishment to the UN. (한편 튀르크 최고대표는 인공지능(AI) 관련 이슈에도 관심을 표한 것으로 전해졌다. 그러자 김 총리는 “한국은 AI 선도 국가로서 유엔 기구들과 함께 하는 ‘글로벌 AI 허브’ 설립을 추진 중”이라고 소개했다. 글로벌 AI 허브는 유엔의 여러 산하기구와 전문기구, 협력기구에 있는 AI 관련 기능을 한곳에 모아 상호 협력하게 하자는 것으로, 한국 정부가 구상했으며 유엔에 이를 한국에 설립하자고 제안하고 있다.)

Prime Minister Kim said, “We aim to discuss ethics and standards surrounding AI through the Global AI Hub,” and added, “It would be good to have meaningful exchanges with the OHCHR from the perspective of AI and human rights.” (김 총리는 “글로벌 AI 허브를 통해 AI를 둘러싼 윤리와 표준 등에 관해 논의를 해 나가고자 한다”며 “AI와 인권이라는 관점에서 OHCHR 측과도 의미 있는 의견 교환이 이뤄지면 좋을 것”이라고 했다.)

In response, High Commissioner Türk expressed “strong support for the purpose of the Global AI Hub” and stated, “The OHCHR will also cooperate.” (이에 대해 튀르크 최고대표는 “글로벌 AI 허브의 취지에 적극 공감한다”며 “OHCHR로서도 협력해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

Additionally, High Commissioner Türk expressed interest in North Korea’s human rights issues, including the problems of separated families, abductees, and detainees. The OHCHR maintains an office in Seoul to monitor and document the human rights situation in North Korea. In this regard, High Commissioner Türk said, “The OHCHR intends to play its necessary role.” (아울러, 튀르크 최고대표는 이산가족, 납북자, 억류자 문제 등 북한 인권 문제에 대해서도 관심을 표명했다. OHCHR은 서울사무소를 두고 북한 인권 상황을 모니터링해 기록하고 있기도 하다. 이와 관련해 튀르크 최고대표는 “OHCHR 차원에서도 필요한 역할을 해 나가고자 한다”고 했다.)

In response, Prime Minister Kim said, “Let’s continue to communicate,” according to the Prime Minister’s Office. An official from the Prime Minister’s Office stated, “This was a general-level response, and there were no specific discussions.” (그러자 김 총리는 “계속해서 소통해 나가자”고 답했다고 총리실은 전했다. 총리실 관계자는 “일반적인 차원의 답변을 한 것이고, 구체적인 논의가 있었던 것은 아니다”라고 했다.)

item.title: "We will connect a divided city into one"... Park Wan-soo and Na Dong-yeon announce joint pledges for Yangsan (“단절된 도시 하나로 잇겠다”… 박완수·나동연, 양산 합동공약 발표)
item.description:
"We will connect a divided city into one"... Park Wan-soo and Na Dong-yeon announce joint pledges for Yangsan (“단절된 도시 하나로 잇겠다”… 박완수·나동연, 양산 합동공약 발표)

Ahead of the June 3 local elections, People Power Party candidate for Gyeongsangnam-do Governor Park Wan-soo and same-party candidate for Yangsan Mayor Na Dong-yeon unveiled a blueprint for Yangsan's great leap forward. They emphasized that if Busan and Gyeongsangnam-do undergo administrative integration in the future, Yangsan will grow into a key hub, and they prioritized expanding the transportation network. (6·3지방선거를 앞두고 국민의힘 박완수 경남도지사 후보와 같은 당 나동연 양산시장 후보가 양산 대도약을 담은 청사진을 발표했다. 향후 부산·경남이 행정 통합을 할 경우 양산시가 핵심 거점으로 성장할 도시라면서 교통망 확충 등을 최우선으로 해나가겠다고 강조했다.)

The two held a joint press conference at Gyeongsangnam-do Provincial Office on the 13th and announced representative pledges for Yangsan City. (두 사람은 13일 경남도청에서 합동 기자회견을 열고 양산시 대표 공약을 발표했다.)

First, they promised to construct a tunnel on Local Road No. 1028, connecting Sangbuk and Eungsang, which will link the eastern (Eungsang) and western (Sangbuk) living zones of Yangsan, divided by geographical limitations, in the shortest distance. Yangsan's living zones are split into western and eastern areas by Cheonseongsan Mountain, which stands over 900 meters high. The Sangbuk-to-Eungsang tunnel will bore through Cheonseongsan Mountain to connect the two regions via the shortest route. Candidate Park said, "During the next adjustment of national highway routes, we are simultaneously pursuing a plan to extend the endpoint of National Highway No. 2 and conducting a basic planning service for the province to directly construct the road as a local route," adding, "Regardless of the method, we will break ground within the term of the 9th popularly elected administration." <<> Other transportation network expansion pledges were announced, including the early opening of Local Highway No. 60, which crosses the Nakdong River to connect Gimhae Maeri to Yangsan, the introduction of the Greater Bus (G-Bus) rapid transit connecting Changwon, Busan, and Ulsan, and the passage of a preliminary feasibility study for the southeastern regional circular metropolitan railway linking Gimhae, Yangsan, and Ulsan. <<> Region-specific pledges were also presented. They promised to build a multipurpose sports center in eastern Yangsan, an area lacking cultural, welfare, and sports facilities compared to the western region, which includes Mulgeum New Town and the city hall. Plans were also announced to upgrade the Eungsang Branch Office to an eastern administrative building. <<> They pledged to designate the Dongmyeon and Sasong area, which has seen a rapid population increase due to new town development, as a special education zone to attract specialized high schools. <<> Candidate Na announced plans to develop the idle land of Pusan National University's Yangsan Campus, in connection with the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport's spatial innovation zone leading project, into an R&D complex blending residential areas and parks. They also pledged active support for the development of Jeungsan New Town in Mulgeum-eup. <<> The two candidates stated, "We will not stop working to connect Yangsan, divided between east and west, into one, and to create a Yangsan where advanced industries like bio and culture and leisure flourish." (우선 지형적 한계로 분리된 양산의 동부(웅상)와 서부(상북) 생활권을 최단 거리로 연결할 지방도 1028호선인 상북~웅상 간 터널 건설을 약속했다. 양산은 높이 900m가 넘는 천성산으로 서부권과 동부권으로 생활권이 나뉜다. 상북~웅상 간 터널은 천성산을 관통해 두 지역을 최단 거리로 연결한다. 박 후보는 “차기 국도 노선 조정 시 국도 2호선 종점을 연장하는 방안과 함께 지방도로로 도가 직접 건설하기 위한 기본 계획 용역을 동시에 추진하고 있다”며 “어떤 식으로든 민선 9기 임기 내 첫 삽을 뜨겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: USFK Commander: "Korea's Manufacturing Capabilities Strengthen ROK-US Alliance Deterrence" (주한미군사령관 “韓 제조 역량이 한미동맹 억제력 강화”)
item.description:
USFK Commander: "Korea's Manufacturing Capabilities Strengthen ROK-US Alliance Deterrence" (주한미군사령관 “韓 제조 역량이 한미동맹 억제력 강화”)

Commander of US Forces Korea (USFK), General Xavier Brunson, stated that "South Korea's advanced manufacturing capabilities can translate into deterrence." (제이비어 브런슨 주한미군 사령관은 “한국의 첨단 제조 역량은 억제력으로 바뀔 수 있다”고 말했다.)

In a keynote speech at the Association of the United States Army's LANPAC Symposium held in Hawaii on the 12th (local time), General Brunson said, "The core of the National Defense Strategy is a dramatic strengthening of the defense industrial base of allies and increased burden sharing. Sustainment is not the tail; it is the 'teeth' that become the core of deterrence." He added, "We will strengthen the defense supply chain, which I call the 'Fortress Chain,' in Korea, and operationalize advanced manufacturing capabilities to transform our presence in the theater into a permanent deterrent." This was interpreted as a statement that could strengthen the deterrence of not only USFK but also the ROK-US alliance against North Korean threats. <<> On the same day, General Brunson presented a blueprint for defense support by highlighting Korea's MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul) capabilities. "South Korean shipyards have successfully completed depot-level maintenance for the US Navy's transport ships USNS Wally Schirra and USNS Cesar Chavez, and two additional vessels are already on the waiting list for maintenance," he said. "This is the operational blueprint of the 'Fortress Chain' we are pursuing." He added, "We will utilize 'Special Repair Authority' and implement advanced manufacturing capabilities, from 3D printing to local parts procurement." Special Repair Authority refers to the discretion to maintain US military weapon systems locally without sending them to maintenance depots in the continental United States. <<> General Brunson emphasized, "The key is recognizing the immense distance between US bases and Korea. Partnering with GM in Korea to fix equipment on the spot using 15,000 personnel locally, rather than sending it to Detroit, and bringing Rock Island (the US Army's arsenal) forward—that's what we aim to do." Testifying before the US Congress's Armed Services Committee last month, General Brunson stated that Korea would be designated as a "Regional Sustainment Hub" to expand logistical cooperation. His latest remarks are seen as an extension of this initiative. <<> He also highlighted the need to strengthen USFK capabilities on the Korean Peninsula to counter North Korea. "The current forces on the Korean Peninsula are mostly a rotational brigade and firepower units," General Brunson said. "The majority of existing USFK forces are essentially in place to prepare mainland troops for combat and to send families home." He added, "I want to deploy a Multi-Domain Task Force (MDTF) to Korea. Domains like cyber, electronic warfare, and space can play a major role in the competition phase." He concluded, "We must find the next step to see, sense, and understand faster than our adversaries." (브런슨 사령관은 12일(현지시각) 미국 하와이에서 열린 미국육군협회 태평양지상군(LANPAC) 심포지엄 기조연설에서 “(미국) 국가 방위 전략(NDS)은 동맹국 국방 산업 기반의 획기적 강화와 분담(Burden Sharing)의 확대가 핵심”이라며 “군수(Sustainment)는 꼬리가 아니라 억제력의 핵심이 되는 ‘이빨’”이라고 말했다. 브런슨 사령관은 ‘요새망’(fortress chain)이라는 방산판 ‘공급망’(supply chain)을 한국에서 강화하겠다며 “첨단 제조 역량을 전력화해 전구 내 우리의 존재감(footprint)을 영구적인 억제력(deterrent)으로 탈바꿈시키겠다”고 했다. 주한미군 뿐만 아니라 한미동맹의 대북 위협에 대한 억제력을 강화시킬 수 있다는 의미로 해석됐다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "Local elections must purge the insurrection... The People Power Party is not qualified to contest the elections" (정청래 “지방선거로 내란 청산해야… 국힘은 선거 임할 자격 없어”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae: "Local elections must purge the insurrection... The People Power Party is not qualified to contest the elections" (정청래 “지방선거로 내란 청산해야… 국힘은 선거 임할 자격 없어” )

Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 13th, "The June 3 local elections are elections that will judge the December 3 martial law insurrection," adding, "The People Power Party will face the harsh judgment of public sentiment." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 13일 “6·3 지방선거는 12·3 비상계엄 내란을 심판하는 선거”라며 “국민의힘은 민심의 혹독한 심판을 받을 것”이라고 했다.)

Leader Jung made this statement during a press conference at the National Assembly that morning. He continued, "The war against the insurrection is not over yet," and "Yoon Suk Yeol, the mastermind of the insurrection, has only received a life sentence, while the People Power Party is openly carrying out 'Yoon Again nominations,' mocking the people." (정 대표는 이날 오전 국회에서 기자회견을 통해 이같이 밝혔다. 정 대표는 “내란과의 전쟁은 아직 끝나지 않았다”며 “내란 수괴 윤석열은 무기징역에 그쳤고, 국민의힘은 대놓고 ‘윤 어게인 공천’을 단행하면서 국민을 우롱하고 있다”고 했다.)

Leader Jung further stated, "Looking at the constitutional amendment bill scrapped due to the People Power Party's obstructionism, the insurrection is still ongoing," and "This amendment bill included provisions to clarify the procedures for declaring and lifting martial law. If the People Power Party had felt even a shred of responsibility, they would not have so outrageously scrapped this amendment bill." (정 대표는 이어 “국민의힘의 어깃장으로 폐기된 개헌안만 보아도 내란은 현재진행형”이라며 “이번 개헌안에는 계엄 선포와 해제 절차를 명확하게 하자는 내용이 담겨 있었다. 국민의힘이 일말의 책임감을 느꼈다면, 이번 개헌안을 그리 무도하게 폐기시키지는 않았을 것”이라고 했다.)

Leader Jung also added, "Furthermore, this amendment bill even included a new clause on balanced national development," and "Considering that local elections are conducted based on the values and philosophy of local autonomy, decentralization, and balanced national development, the People Power Party, which rejected the amendment bill, is not even qualified to participate in the June 3 local elections." (정 대표는 또 “심지어 이번 개헌안에는 국가 균형 발전에 대한 조문 신설도 있었다”며 “지방선거가 지방자치와 지방 분권, 국가 균형 발전의 가치와 철학을 토대로 실시되는 것임을 생각한다면, 개헌안을 거부한 국민의힘은 6·3 지방선거에 임할 자격조차 없다”고 했다.)

Leader Jung said, "I have continually warned that the People Power Party is an anti-constitutional, anti-democratic force that supports the insurrection and could be subject to a review for the dissolution of an unconstitutional political party," and "The People Power Party will face the harsh judgment of public sentiment in these local elections even before any review for party dissolution." (정 대표는 “저는 국민의힘이 내란을 옹호하는 반헌법·반민주 세력이며 위헌 정당 해산 심판의 대상이 될 수 있다는 경고를 끊임없이 해 왔다”며 “국민의힘은 정당 해산 심판 이전에 이번 지방선거에서 민심의 혹독한 심판을 받을 것”이라고 했다.)

Leader Jung concluded, "We must thoroughly judge the insurrection forces through the local elections and purge even the last traces of the insurrection," and "Through this, we must fully normalize the country and establish effective local governments to firmly support the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." (정 대표는 “지방선거를 통해 내란 세력을 확실하게 심판하고, 내란의 티끌까지 청산해야 한다”며 “이를 통해 국가를 완전히 정상화하고 일 잘하는 지방정부를 세워 이재명 정부의 성공을 든든하게 뒷받침해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Cho Jung-sik Named Candidate for Second Half of 22nd National Assembly Speaker (22대 후반기 국회의장 후보에 조정식)
item.description:
Cho Jung-sik Named Candidate for Second Half of 22nd National Assembly Speaker (22대 후반기 국회의장 후보에 조정식)

On the 13th, Representative Cho Jung-sik (Siheung-eul, Gyeonggi Province, six-term) of the Democratic Party of Korea, who received side support from President Lee Jae-myung in a post on X (formerly Twitter), was elected as the candidate for the second half of the 22nd National Assembly Speaker. Representatives Park Ji-won (Haenam-Wando-Jindo, South Jeolla Province, five-term) and Kim Tae-nyeon (Seongnam-Sujeong, Gyeonggi Province, five-term) were eliminated. Representative Nam In-soon (Songpa-byeong, Seoul, four-term) was elected as the candidate for the Democratic Party’s Vice Speaker of the National Assembly. Although the Speaker and Vice Speaker are elected at a plenary session of the National Assembly, with the Democratic Party holding a majority of seats, the candidate who wins the party's internal primary effectively becomes the Speaker. (13일 제22대 국회 후반기 국회의장 후보에 이재명 대통령이 X(옛 트위터)에 글을 올려 측면 지원한 더불어민주당 조정식(경기 시흥을·6선) 의원이 선출됐다. 박지원(전남 해남완도진도·5선)·김태년(경기 성남수정·5선) 의원은 떨어졌다. 민주당 몫 국회부의장 후보에는 남인순(서울 송파병·4선) 의원이 선출됐다. 국회의장·부의장은 국회 본회의에서 선출되지만, 민주당이 국회 과반 의석을 갖고 있기 때문에 사실상 민주당 내부 경선에서 이긴 의원이 의장이 된다.)

The Democratic Party held a general meeting of lawmakers at the National Assembly on the afternoon of the 13th to select candidates for the second-half Speaker and Vice Speaker. For the first time, this primary reflected lawmaker votes and party member votes in an 80:20 ratio. The party member vote was conducted online on the 11th and 12th. The Democratic Party did not disclose the vote counts for each candidate, but Representative Cho secured a majority in the first round, confirming his election without a runoff. (민주당은 이날 오후 국회에서 의원총회를 열어 후반기 국회의장·부의장 후보를 뽑았다. 이번 경선은 처음으로 의원 투표와 함께 권리당원 투표가 80대20의 비율로 반영됐다. 권리당원 투표는 지난 11~12일 온라인으로 진행됐다. 민주당은 각 후보의 득표 수는 공개하지 않았으나, 조 후보는 1차 투표에서 과반을 득표해 결선 없이 당선을 확정지었다.)

In his policy address prior to the lawmaker vote that day, Representative Cho stated, “I, Cho Jung-sik, deeply understand the governing philosophy of the Lee Jae-myung administration and am someone who will take responsibility together,” adding, “I will ensure that the party, government, and National Assembly form a team to deliver tangible results that the public can feel.” He pledged, “We will swiftly complete the parliamentary organization (distribution of standing committee chair positions) by June and handle 100% of legislative tasks for state affairs by December,” and “Bills passed by standing committees will be processed by the Legislation and Judiciary Committee and the plenary session within the same month.” He also announced, “We will immediately form a special committee on constitutional amendment,” aiming to revive the amendment proposal whose recent processing was thwarted. Earlier, at his candidacy announcement press conference on the 4th, Cho had stated he would pursue constitutional amendments centered on a four-year renewable presidency, transferring the Board of Audit and Inspection to the National Assembly, and enshrining lessons from the December 3 insurrection in the constitution. (조 후보는 이날 의원 투표에 앞서 진행된 정견 발표에서 “저 조정식은 이재명 정부의 국정 철학을 뼛속 깊이 이해하고 함께 책임질 사람”이라며 “당정청과 국회가 한 팀을 이뤄 국민이 체감하는 성과를 반드시 만들어 내겠다”고 했다. 그는 “6월에 원(院) 구성(상임위원장 배분)을 신속히 완료하고, 12월까지 국정 과제 입법을 100% 처리하겠다”며 “상임위를 통과한 법안은 그달 내에 법사위와 본회의에서 처리하겠다”고 했다. 또 “즉시 개헌특위를 구성하겠다”며, 최근 처리가 무산된 개헌안 처리를 다시 추진하겠다고도 했다. 조 후보는 앞서 지난 4일 출마 기자회견에서도 대통령 4년 연임제, 감사원 국회 이관, 12·3 내란 교훈의 헌법 명시를 골자로 하는 개헌을 추진하겠다고 했었다.)

In his victory speech, Cho said, “As a National Assembly Speaker from the ruling party, I will closely consult and cooperate with Party Leader Jung Cheong-rae and Floor Leader Han Byung-do to build a swift and productive National Assembly,” vowing, “I will give my all to ensure the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration and a National Assembly that supports the sovereign people.” (조 후보는 당선 인사에서 “집권 여당 출신 국회의장으로서 정청래 당대표, 한병도 원내대표와 긴밀히 협의하고 협력하면서 속도감 있고 성과 있는 국회를 만들어 가겠다”며 “이재명 정부의 성공과 주권자인 국민을 떠받드는 국회가 될 수 있도록 혼신의 힘을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

Representative Cho, with six terms, is the most senior among Democratic Party incumbent lawmakers and is considered a key figure close to Lee, alongside Minister of Justice Jung Sung-ho. Having served as secretary-general during President Lee’s tenure as party leader, he also led the so-called "non-pro-Lee purge" in candidate nominations for the 2024 general election. (조 후보는 민주당 현역 의원 가운데 최다선인 6선으로, 정성호 법무부 장관과 함께 ‘친명 좌장’ 격으로 꼽힌다. 이 대통령의 민주당 대표 시절 사무총장을 지내면서 지난 2024년 총선에서 이른바 ‘비명횡사’ 공천을 주도하기도 했다.)

In political circles, there is an assessment that Representative Cho received multiple forms of support from President Lee in this Speaker election. President Lee appointed Cho, who had already announced his intention to run for the second-half Speaker at the end of last year, as his special political affairs advisor. On the 3rd, when Cho resigned from the special advisor role to run for Speaker, Lee posted on X, “You have always been by my side; I sincerely thank you.” On the 11th, he also explained the purpose of the preferential voting system applied to the Democratic Party’s internal primary on X, sharing a post from a supporter who certified they had voted for Representative Cho in this Speaker election. The People Power Party criticized this as “interference in the Speaker election and blatant meddling in party affairs.” Even within the Democratic Party, some lawmakers raised concerns that “the president’s intent (myeongsim) is clearly with Representative Cho,” and that the president’s de facto public endorsement of Cho was inappropriate. (정치권에서는 조 후보가 이번 국회의장 선거에서 이 대통령으로부터 여러 차례 지원을 받았다는 평가가 나온다. 이 대통령은 지난해 말 이미 후반기 국회의장 선거에 도전하겠다고 밝힌 상태였던 조 후보를 대통령 정무특별보좌관으로 임명했고, 지난 3일 조 후보가 국회의장 선거 출마를 위해 정무특보직을 사임하자 X에 “언제나 함께해 주셨는데 진심으로 감사하다”고 쓰기도 했다. 지난 11일에는 X에 민주당 내부 경선에 적용되는 선호투표제의 취지를 설명하면서, 이번 의장 선거에서 조 의원에게 투표했다고 인증한 지지자의 글을 공유했다. 이를 두고 국민의힘은 “국회의장 선거 개입이자 노골적인 당무 개입”이라고 비판했다. 민주당 내에서도 “명심(明心·이 대통령의 의중)이 조 의원에게 있다”는 말과 함께, 대통령이 조 의원을 사실상 공개 지지한 것은 부적절하다는 의원이 나왔었다.)

On the same day, the People Power Party also elected Representative Park Deok-heum (Boeun-Okcheon-Yeongdong-Goesan, North Chungcheong Province, four-term) as its candidate for one of the two Vice Speaker positions allocated to the opposition. Representative Park received 59 out of 101 votes (58.4%) in the lawmaker vote. The new Speaker and Vice Speaker are expected to be elected at a plenary session scheduled as early as the 20th. (이날 국민의힘도 2인인 국회부의장 가운데 야당 몫 후보자로 박덕흠(충북 보은옥천영동괴산·4선) 의원을 선출했다. 박 후보는 의원 투표에서 101표 가운데 59표(58.4%)를 얻었다. 신임 의장·부의장은 이르면 오는 20일 열리는 본회의에서 선출될 것으로 전망된다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk, with a Bruised Eye from a "Minor Accident," and Kim Yong-nam, with Broken Blood Vessels (“작은 사고” 눈에 멍든 조국, 실핏줄 터진 김용남)
item.description:
Cho Kuk, with a Bruised Eye from a "Minor Accident," and Kim Yong-nam, with Broken Blood Vessels (“작은 사고” 눈에 멍든 조국, 실핏줄 터진 김용남)

Cho Kuk, a candidate from the Rebuilding Korea Party running in the by-election for Pyeongtaek-eul, posted a photo on Facebook on the 13th showing a bruise on his right eye. According to Cho, he was injured while leaving a meeting with residents of an apartment complex the previous day. (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 출마한 조국 조국혁신당 후보가 13일 오른쪽 눈에 멍이 든 사진을 페이스북에서 공개했다. 조 후보는 전날 한 아파트 주민들과 간담회를 마친 뒤 자리를 나서다 다쳤다고 한다.)

On this day, Cho said, "During yesterday's schedule, I had a minor accident where I hit my forehead hard against a door. When I woke up this morning, my eyelid was swollen and bruised." He added, "I went to Seongsim Central Hospital in Anjung, where I live, and received an injection and medication. I am grateful for the warm welcome from the doctors and nurses, as well as the encouragement from the residents who visited the hospital." (조 후보는 이날 “어제 일정 중 이마를 문에 세게 부딪히는 작은 사고가 났다. 자고 일어나니 눈두덩이가 붓고 멍이 들었다”며 “살고 있는 안중 ‘성심중앙병원’에 가서 주사도 맞고 약도 받았다. 의사, 간호사 선생님들의 환대와 내원하신 주민들의 응원에 감사했다”고 했다.)

Cho further stated, "Former directors, senior secretaries, and secretaries who worked at the Blue House during the Moon Jae-in administration came to the election office. They were surprised to see the bruise on my right eye, but encouraged me, saying it was a 'lucky charm to ward off bad luck.'" He added, "Citizens I meet on the streets are also startled." (조 후보는 또 “문재인 정부 청와대에서 근무했던 실장, 수석, 비서관님들이 선거 사무소로 오셨다. 오른쪽 눈에 멍이 든 걸 보시고 놀라셨지만 ‘액땜’했다고 격려해 주신다”며 “거리에서 뵙는 시민들도 깜짝 놀라신다”고 했다.)

Cho said, "I apologize for not taking better care. It seems it will take 2-3 days for the bruise to completely disappear." He continued, "But even with a bruised eye, I keep marching on." (조 후보는 “관리 잘못한 점 죄송하다. 멍이 완전히 사라지는 데는 2~3일 걸릴 것 같다”며 “그러나 멍든 눈으로도 뚜벅이는 계속된다”고 했다.)

Similarly, Kim Yong-nam, a candidate from the Democratic Party of Korea running in the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election, posted a photo of his eye with broken blood vessels on the same day. He said, "I shouldn't be like this already." (마찬가지로 평택을 재선거에 출마한 김용남 더불어민주당 후보는 이날 눈에 실핏줄이 터진 사진을 올렸다. 그는 “벌써 이러면 안 되는데”라고 했다.)

The Pyeongtaek-eul by-election is shaping up as a five-way race including not only Kim and Cho but also Yoo Ui-dong from the People Power Party, Kim Jae-yeon from the Progressive Party, and Hwang Kyo-ahn from the Liberty and Innovation Party. Recent opinion polls show a close contest among Kim, Yoo, and Cho. (평택을 재선거는 김 후보와 조 후보 외에도 유의동 국민의힘 후보, 김재연 진보당 후보, 황교안 자유와혁신 후보 등 5파전이 벌어지고 있다. 최근 여론조사에선 김 후보와 유 후보, 조 후보 간에 접전이 벌어지는 것으로 나타났다.)

item.title: Chung Dong-young Meets UN Human Rights Chief: "Reuniting Separated Families is the Most Urgent Human Rights Issue" (정동영, 유엔 인권대표 만나 “이산가족 상봉 가장 중요한 인권 현안”)
item.description:
Chung Dong-young Meets UN Human Rights Chief: "Reuniting Separated Families is the Most Urgent Human Rights Issue" (정동영, 유엔 인권대표 만나 “이산가족 상봉 가장 중요한 인권 현안” )

Unification Minister Chung Dong-young met with visiting UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk on the 13th and highlighted the reunion of separated families as the most critical human rights issue between the two Koreas. (정동영 통일부 장관은 13일 방한중인 볼커 튀르크 유엔 인권최고대표와 만나 현재 가장 중요한 남북 간 인권 현안으로 이산가족 상봉을 꼽았다.)

According to the Ministry of Unification, during the meeting with Türk, Minister Chung explained the South Korean government's efforts to improve inter-Korean relations and cited family reunions as the most important and urgent human rights concern between the two Koreas. Minister Chung positively assessed North Korea's initiatives on disability-related systems and awareness improvement, as well as its cooperation with the international community, stating, "There is a need for our government to respond appropriately to efforts aimed at promoting the rights of persons with disabilities." He added, "It is important to substantially improve the lives of North Korean residents through dialogue and exchange between the two Koreas." (통일부에 따르면 정 장관은 이날 튀르크 대표와 만난 자리에서 우리 정부의 남북관계 개선 노력을 설명하면서 남북 간 가장 중요하고 시급한 인권 현안으로 이산가족 상봉을 언급했다. 정 장관은 북한의 장애인 관련 제도 및 인식개선 노력과 국제 사회 협력에 대해 긍정 평가하면서 “장애인 권리 증진 노력에 대한 우리 정부의 호응이 필요하다”고 했다. 그러면서 “남북 간 대화와 교류를 통해 북한 주민들의 삶을 실질적으로 개선해 나가는 것이 중요하다”고 했다.)

The UN High Commissioner for Human Rights outlined his role, including reporting on the human rights situation in North Korea, and emphasized the need to build trust between the two Koreas through human rights. The Ministry of Unification reported that Türk expressed a willingness to cooperate with North Korea on areas of interest to Pyongyang, such as promoting the rights of persons with disabilities and eliminating discrimination against women. (튀르크 인권최고대표는 북한인권 상황 보고 등 인권최고대표로서의 역할을 설명하고 “인권을 통한 남북 간 신뢰구축이 필요하다”고 했다. 이어 장애인 권리증진, 여성차별 철폐 등 북한이 관심을 가지는 부분에서 북한과의 협력 의지를 밝혔다고 통일부는 전했다.)

The meeting was held behind closed doors, as agreed upon by both sides beforehand. This marks the first official visit to South Korea by a UN High Commissioner for Human Rights in 11 years, since Zeid Ra'ad Al Hussein in 2015. Türk, an Austrian expert in international human rights law, began his term as UN High Commissioner for Human Rights in 2022. (이날 면담은 양측의 사전 협의에 따라 비공개로 진행됐다. 유엔 인권최고대표의 공식 방한은 2015년 자이드 알 후세인 이후 11년 만이다. 튀르크 대표는 오스트리아 출신의 국제인권법 전문가로 2022년 유엔 인권최고대표 임기를 시작했다.)

During a press conference at the Seoul Global Center on the same day, Türk, who has been on an official visit to South Korea since the 12th, addressed the handling of two North Korean soldiers captured as prisoners of war by Ukrainian forces, stating, "The principle of non-refoulement must be applied," and "North Korean prisoners of war naturally must be subject to international humanitarian law and international human rights law." (12일부터 한국을 공식 방문 중인 튀르크 대표는 이날 서울글로벌센터에서 가진 기자회견에서 우크라이나군에 붙잡힌 북한군 포로 2명의 신병 처리와 관련해 “강제송환 금지 원칙‘(Non-refoulement)이 적용돼야 한다”며 “북한의 전쟁포로(POW)는 당연히 국제인도주의법, 국제인권법의 적용을 받아야 한다”고 했다.)

This is the first time a UN High Commissioner for Human Rights has mentioned applying this principle in connection with North Korean prisoners of war in Ukraine. The two North Korean soldiers have clearly expressed their intention to defect to South Korea through handwritten letters delivered to a local organization of North Korean defectors. (유엔인권최고대표가 우크라이나의 북한군 포로와 관련해 이 원칙 적용을 언급한 것은 이번이 처음이다. 북한군 포로 2명은 국내 탈북민 단체에 전달한 친필 편지 등을 통해 한국으로의 귀순 의사를 분명히 한 상태다.)

Regarding the human rights situation of ordinary North Koreans, Türk said, "Serious human rights violations are still ongoing and must not be ignored," adding, "Accountability is needed for the serious human rights abuses that have plagued North Korean residents for decades." He also expressed support for holding criminal accountability, including referring North Korea's human rights violations to the International Criminal Court (ICC). (튀르크 대표는 이날 북한 내부 주민들의 인권 상황과 관련해서는 “심각한 인권 침해가 지금도 계속되고 있으며, 이를 외면해서는 안 된다”며 “북한(주민)을 수십년간 괴롭힌 중대한 인권침해에 대해 책임 규명이 필요하다”고 했다. 북한의 인권침해행위에 대한 국제형사재판소(ICC) 회부 등 형사적 책임 규명을 지지한다고도 했다.)

item.title: Lee Cheol-woo: "Stagnation of Daegu-Gyeongbuk Region Is Not Due to Support for a Specific Party, but to Seoul-Centered Policies" (이철우 “TK발전 정체는 특정정당 지지가 아니라 수도권 중심 정책 탓”)
item.description:
Lee Cheol-woo: "Stagnation of Daegu-Gyeongbuk Region Is Not Due to Support for a Specific Party, but to Seoul-Centered Policies" (이철우 “TK발전 정체는 특정정당 지지가 아니라 수도권 중심 정책 탓” )

Lee Cheol-woo, a preliminary candidate for the People Power Party's Gyeongsangbuk-do governor, strongly criticized the Democratic Party's claim on the 13th that the stagnation of development in the Daegu-Gyeongbuk (TK) region is due to the residents' support for a specific political party. The preliminary candidate argued that it is not the political choices of local residents, but the Seoul-centered policies that have deprived the TK region of development opportunities. (이철우 국민의힘 경북지사 예비후보는 13일 대구·경북(TK)의 발전 정체를 시도민의 특정 정당 지지 탓으로 돌린 더불어민주당의 주장을 강하게 비판했다. 지역민의 정치적 선택이 아니라 수도권 중심 정책 때문에 TK가 발전할 기회를 빼앗겼다는 게 이 예비후보의 주장이다.)

In a post on his Facebook that day, the preliminary candidate stated, "Recently, the Democratic Party, from its party leader to about 60 lawmakers, came down to Daegu and misled the residents by saying things like, 'Daegu-Gyeongbuk failed to develop because it only supported one party.' Even now, Democratic Party candidates are repeating the same rhetoric as if simply changing the party would make Daegu-Gyeongbuk prosper overnight." He then retorted, "Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam, Chungcheong, Gangwon, and Jeju have had their political allegiances shift back and forth, but are all those regions thriving?" (이 예비후보는 이날 자신의 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “얼마 전 민주당이 당대표부터 국회의원 60여 명까지 대구에 내려와 ‘대구·경북이 한 정당만 지지해서 발전하지 못했다’는 식으로 말하며 시도민을 호도했다. 지금도 민주당 후보들은 마치 정당만 바꾸면 대구·경북이 하루아침에 발전할 것처럼 똑같은 말을 반복하고 있다”며 “부산·울산·경남, 충청, 강원, 제주 등은 정치 세력이 이쪽 갔다 저쪽 갔다 바뀌었는데, 그 지역들이 모두 잘살고 있느냐”고 반문했다.)

The preliminary candidate pointed out, "The problem is not about party colors, but about Seoul-centered policies and national management." As evidence, he noted that in 1949, the population of Gyeongbuk, including Daegu, was 3.2 million; Gyeongnam, including Busan and Ulsan, was 3.13 million; and Gwangju and Jeonnam were 3.04 million—similar figures. However, today, Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam has grown to about 7.5 million, while Daegu-Gyeongbuk remains around 5 million, and Gwangju-Jeonnam stands at about 3.2 million. The preliminary candidate argued, "Gyeongnam grew into the Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam economic bloc thanks to the port of Busan, the experience of being a wartime capital, and the axis of national industrialization. In contrast, Daegu-Gyeongbuk, being an inland hub, did not receive sufficient growth opportunities amid Seoul-centered policies, and Gwangju-Jeonnam faced even more challenging industrial and locational conditions, widening the population gap even further." He directly questioned, "How can this be blamed on the political inclinations of the residents?" (이 예비후보는 “(지역 발전) 문제는 정당 색깔이 아니라 수도권 중심의 정책과 국가 운영”이라고 지적했다. 그 근거로 이 예비후보는 1949년 당시 대구를 포함한 경북 인구는 320만명, 부산과 울산이 포함된 경남은 313만명, 광주와 전남은 304만명으로 비슷했지만, 현재 부·울·경은 약 750만명으로 성장한 반면, 대구·경북은 약 500만명, 광주·전남은 약 320만명 수준에 머물러 있다는 점에 주목했다. 이 예비후보는 “경남은 부산이라는 항만, 피란수도의 경험, 국가 산업화의 축을 타고 부·울·경 경제권으로 성장한 반면 대구·경북은 내륙 중심 구조와 수도권 집중 정책 속에서 성장의 기회를 충분히 받지 못했고, 광주·전남은 더 어려운 산업·입지 여건 속에서 인구 격차가 더 크게 벌어졌다”며 “이것이 어떻게 주민들의 정치 성향 탓이냐”고 직격했다.)

The preliminary candidate further criticized, "When the 5 million residents of Daegu-Gyeongbuk sought to create a regional era model through administrative integration to overcome the Seoul-centric single-pole system, it was the Democratic Party that blocked it with political calculations." He pointedly asked, "Do those who prevented the integration of Daegu-Gyeongbuk now have the right to talk about changing political parties?" He emphasized, "Daegu-Gyeongbuk did not collapse due to politics; it was deprived of opportunities because of Seoul-centered policies. The answer is not a party switch but ushering in a regional era, and it requires not just talk of balanced development but the integration of Daegu-Gyeongbuk." (이어 이 예비후보는 “500만대구·경북 시도민이 행정 통합을 통해 수도권 일극 체제를 넘어서는 지방 시대 모델을 만들려 할 때, 정치적 계산으로 이를 막아선 사람들이 바로 민주당”이라며 “대구·경북 통합을 막아 놓은 사람들이 이제 와서 정당 교체를 말할 자격이 있느냐”고 꼬집었다. 그는 “대구·경북은 정치 탓에 주저앉은 것이 아니라 수도권 중심 정책 때문에 기회를 빼앗긴 것”이라며 “답은 정당 교체가 아니라 지방 시대를 여는 것이고, 말뿐인 균형 발전이 아니라 대구·경북 통합이 필요하다”고 강조했다.)

In conclusion, the preliminary candidate stressed, "We must preserve the proud pride of Daegu-Gyeongbuk, which has led history. We should move not toward a handout society that gives things away for free, but toward a healthy free democratic market economy where those who work hard are rewarded. With the strength of Daegu-Gyeongbuk and the power of the people, we must surely overcome the Seoul-centric single-pole system." (끝으로 이 예비후보는 “역사를 이끌어온 자랑스러운 대구·경북의 자존심을 지켜야 한다. 공짜로 나눠 주는 배급식 사회가 아니라 땀 흘려 일한 사람이 보상받는 건강한 자유민주주의 시장경제로 나아가야 한다”며 “대구·경북의 힘으로, 국민의 힘으로 수도권 일극 체제를 반드시 넘어서야 한다”고 강조했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Kim Yong-beom's remarks refer to 'excess tax revenue dividend'… Claims about excess profits are slander" (李대통령 “김용범 말은 ‘초과세수 배당’…초과이윤 주장은 음해")
item.description:
President Lee: "Kim Yong-beom's remarks refer to 'excess tax revenue dividend'… Claims about excess profits are slander" (李대통령 “김용범 말은 ‘초과세수 배당’…초과이윤 주장은 음해")

President Lee Jae-myung directly refuted reports about Cheong Wa Dae policy chief Kim Yong-beom's mention of a national dividend on the 13th, calling them "slanderous fake news." (이재명 대통령은 13일 김용범 청와대 정책실장의 국민배당금 언급을 다룬 보도에 대해 “음해성 가짜뉴스”라고 직접 반박했다.)

President Lee wrote on X (formerly Twitter) that day, "What Director Kim said is that (we) are considering a plan to distribute the nation's excess tax revenue generated from excess profits in the artificial intelligence (AI) sector to the people." President Lee added, "Some media outlets edited this remark and spread slanderous fake news claiming that 'Director Kim argued for considering a plan to distribute corporate excess profits to the people.'" <<> He then questioned, "Even though Director Kim denied this and kindly provided an explanation, and related reports have been published, why do they still persist with such slanderous reporting?" adding, "Political criticism or blame, if not based on facts, harms democracy." <<> In a post on Facebook on the 11th, Director Kim said, "The fruits of the AI infrastructure era are not solely the result of specific companies," and mentioned a "national dividend system" to return them to the people. When controversy arose over this post, Kim explained, "It's about utilizing excess tax revenue." <<> However, foreign media reported that the stock market fell due to Kim's post, and opposition parties such as the People Power Party criticized it as "communist thinking." Cheong Wa Dae stated, "The content posted by Director Kim is a personal opinion unrelated to any internal discussions or reviews within Cheong Wa Dae." (이 대통령은 이날 X(엑스·옛 트위터)에 “김 실장이 한 말은 인공지능(AI) 부문 초과이윤으로 발생하는 국가의 초과 세수를 국민배당하는 방안(을) 검토(한다는 것)”라며 이같이 썼다. 이 대통령은 “일부 언론이 이 발언을 편집해 ‘김 실장이 기업의 초과이윤을 국민배당하는 방안 검토를 주장했다’는 음해성 가짜뉴스를 유포했다”고 했다.)
